verdict.rationale: Google Cloud runs a public status page covering its services, plus Personalized Service Health for project-specific incident detail, alerts, API data and logs. Hands-on reports say the page lagged real outages by about an hour and showed services as 'Available' during an incident, so it may not be a reliable real-time surface. missing for 10: documented per-service incident history, published post-incident reports, independent evidence of timely and accurate status updates.

support.subject: As an operations lead, outages are owned in public — a real status/health surface with per-service history and post-incident reports

citations.quote: This page provides status information on the services that are part of Google Cloud.
Use Personalized Service Health for a more detailed overview of incidents affecting your Google Cloud projects, including custom alerts, API data and logs.
